cargoLinkChain: Sealed complete Cargo --message-format=json raw and -vv log must show successful current build-script-executed for exact registry doltlite0.51.0 package_id; linked_libs includes static=doltlite, z, pthread on Mac/Linux; linked_paths has native=<exact parent of retained libdoltlite.a>. Crosscheck successful nonfresh compiler-artifact for that same dep and worker executable. Actual worker rustc -vv command --extern doltlite=<the dep rlib> and matching -L native=<archive parent> crosslinks native output to current worker artifact. Default-role final executable SHA equals independent worker strong witness. Cargo build-finished success required. Consumer must fail if these lines/JSON are omitted, stale, ambiguous or point elsewhere.
claimLimit: This verifies observed compiler/ar/Cargo/rustc linkage and actual resulting artifact; it does not invent a separately observed ld child argv/PID. tools.linker identifies qualified actual rustc linker/toolchain. If a downstream acceptance condition requires exact internal ld invocation, v1 is insufficient and must fail closed pending a separately reviewed recorder extension.
compileToArchive: Required successful raw compiler command includes exact pinned vendor/doltlite.c, -c, an unambiguous -o object path; it is not a probe. Match object nativeOutputs entry and retained actual object SHA. Required actual successful ar command names libdoltlite.a as output and this same object operand; required output archive SHA is captured after Cargo terminal. Retain all ar invocations, including symbol-index commands. File naming/packageName alone is insufficient. Actual ar table/member evidence under commandIndex extra evidence is not introduced by this design; if unavailable, command/raw-object/archive relationship plus Cargo current link chain is the supported v1 claim, not an independent binary disassembly proof.
evidenceLayout: Cargo raw JSON/verbose log are sealed regular snapshots (proof in original normal witness and native cargoVerboseLog). Index mappings include all matching native proof paths. No lookup of moving workspace, OUT_DIR, registry or original tools by consumer.
inventoryRule: Require all ten origin=registry/logicalPath keys from pinned-members.json exactly once in both source inventories with expected SHA/bytes. Other crate sources never substitute for them. Resolve actual file operand from command cwd only, then bind to this exact inventory path/SHA and its sealed snapshot.
productionStatus: Required acceptance rules, not a claim that an actual normal worker has already been built under them.
